scope.basis: Diff since HEAD plus complete new test files and directly relevant shared-helper callers.

summary: No unresolved blocking finding in the final bounded diff. Two review findings were corrected before this verdict.

findings.category: Receive address integrity and async state
findings.title: Reopening Receive allowed copying a prior response while a fresh address was loading
findings.location: relay/webapp.html:1807 resetWalletReceive; relay/webapp.html:1823 walletReceive; relay/webapp.html:1709 walletRender; relay/webapp.html:3056 send listener
findings.originalEvidence: Independent synthetic deferred-fetch execution of actual HEAD walletReceive and receive-copy listener copied prior address A, then displayed response B. The first candidate reproduced the same mismatch beside completed clipboard feedback.
findings.impact: A user could paste the previous receive address while the panel displayed a newer address and completed-copy feedback.
findings.resolution: Opening clears previous address and QR and disables copying. A generation token invalidates responses on close, send navigation and wallet identity changes. HTTP failure or invalid/empty address stays source-free and disabled. Clipboard feedback is invalidated together with receive state.
findings.verification: Final source review plus independent VM execution of actual walletRender, walletReceive, reset helpers, receive listener and send listener passed. Browser and regression additions exercise reordered responses and loading state.

findings.title: The Python wrapper accepted Node exit zero without confirming scenario completion
findings.originalEvidence: The wrapper originally asserted only returncode == 0. An intermediate independent review harness demonstrated a Node process exiting zero with an unresolved Promise and no completion output.
findings.impact: A future test or implementation regression that leaves a deferred request unresolved could produce a false green result.
findings.resolution: The wrapper now parses stdout and requires the exact scenario and PASS result object in addition to successful exit.
findings.verification: Final wrapper bytes inspected; JSON parse and equality assertion are present. The implementation agent reports all 76 focused tests passed after the correction.

securityObservations: Receive feedback uses a distinct live-status element; the receive address and QR are not used as feedback targets.
Clipboard success and optional haptic occur only after writeText resolves. Rejection, missing API, synchronous error and empty text fail with a generic message.
Per-element operation identity prevents older copy completion or failure from replacing a newer copy state; repeat copies retain the original feedback label.
The shortened-address caller uses the captured wallet address and the ownership-proof caller reads textarea value. Neither copies its feedback label.
New UI content uses textContent and explicit DOM queries. No new executable HTML sink, third-party dependency, secret storage or money writer is introduced.

The browser runner serves synthetic fixtures at e4.invalid, retains deny-by-default routing, blocks service workers and requires non-root sandboxed Chrome. Held receive requests are fulfilled locally and do not continue to a network destination.

independentVerification.behavioralRuntime: Node VM with synthetic DOM, clipboard, timers, formatting and fetch boundaries; production functions and listeners extracted from exact final HTML.
checks: Loading clears previous address and QR; simulated native disabled-copy activation cannot write.
Actual receive listener preserves source address and ignores stale clipboard completion.
Actual walletRender identity change invalidates source and pending clipboard feedback.
Actual send listener invalidates a pending receive response.
Late failure from an older receive cannot erase a newer valid response.
HTTP failure and empty or malformed address remain disabled and source-free.
otherChecks: node --check passed for both scoped CJS runners.
Python AST parse passed for the scoped pytest wrapper.
git diff --check passed for the tracked scoped changes.
All four file hashes revalidated immediately before writing this report.
independentVerification.earlierCandidateChecks: Independent shared-element checks also verified actual shortened-address rerender/listener replacement, cross-element success/failure isolation and generic diagnostics. Shared clipboard implementation is unchanged in the final candidate.

limits: This is a bounded source and test review, not a repository-wide security audit or E4 gate closure.
No production deployment, runtime health, customer data, credentials, wallet signing, transaction or network workload was performed by this reviewer.

The initial local systemctl status check was denied by the sandbox. Writer ownership and browser network-namespace isolation are supervisor responsibilities; this review does not independently attest host runtime state.
Independent behavioral checks use synthetic browser boundaries. Actual clipboard/platform behavior, Telegram, WebKit, iOS and human usability are not established by this reviewer.
Backend address ownership, address checksum semantics, QR payload correctness, API authorization and unrelated payment instructions are outside this diff review.
No external research or scanners were claimed; applicable local security guidance and direct source/behavior evidence were used.
